funFacts: Golden State Valkyries are one win away from reaching the WNBA Finals in their inaugural season.
Las Vegas Aces must win three straight games to defend their crown.
Game 3 takes place at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas on Peacock.

keyPlayers.name: A'ja Wilson
keyPlayers.hook: Scored 24 in Game 2 and must carry the two-time champions at home facing elimination.

keyPlayers.name: Gabby Williams
keyPlayers.hook: Averaging 22.5 points in the series after scoring 25 and 20 in the opening two games.

headToHead: Valkyries lead 2-0 after victories of 71-60 and 83-81 in San Francisco.
resultSummary: FINAL: Aces 86, Valkyries 79 at Michelob ULTRA Arena. Wilson 31 pts, 14 reb keeps Las Vegas alive. Valkyries lead series 2-1.
headline: WNBA Semifinals Game 3: Aces face elimination trailing Valkyries 0-2
whyCareReason: The expansion Valkyries can close out a historic sweep in Las Vegas, while A'ja Wilson fights to extend the Aces' season.
teaser: Burton's late triple and Stokes' block gave Golden State an 83-81 Game 2 win. Tipoff is 9:30 p.m. ET on Peacock.
story: The Las Vegas Aces host the Golden State Valkyries in an elimination Game 3 on Friday night at Michelob ULTRA Arena. The expansion Valkyries have stunned the basketball world by taking a 2-0 series advantage, grinding out a 71-60 defensive masterclass in Game 1 and surviving an 83-81 thriller in Game 2. Gabby Williams and Tiffany Hayes have punished the Aces with perimeter scoring, while Veronica Burton's go-ahead 3-pointer with 41 seconds left decided Game 2. Facing a sweep on home wood, A'ja Wilson and Chelsea Gray must summon their championship pedigree to keep Las Vegas alive and force Game 4 on Sunday.
stakes: A Valkyries win sends an expansion team to the WNBA Finals in year one. An Aces win keeps the series alive.
rivalryAngle: The defending champions find themselves pushed to the limit by the league's newest franchise.
